# Vigil

Vendored `vigil.js` from [kaladinstorm84/Vigil](https://github.com/kaladinstorm84/Vigil)
at commit `cccaf9149603cd3448014c5999208ca26a535420` (v0.6.0), under the
included MIT license.

SignalBox uses `Vigil.sparkline` with its existing dashboard request loop and
theme. It does not mount polling controllers or load Vigil's global CSS reset.
No CDN or runtime network dependency is required.
